Ms. Neelima Mishra Joshi, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned A.G.A for the State.
3. This appeal has been preferred by the 
appellant/convict under Section 374 r/w 383 of Cr.P.C. 
against the impugned judgment and order dated 24 & 
28.05.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge 
(POCSO)/Additional District & Session Judge, District 
Dehradun in S.S.T. No.50/2021, whereby 
appellant/convict has been sentenced as under:-
Sl. No. Conviction Sentence Fine Sentence in lieu of 
fine
1. 6 of POCSO 
Act
Life 
imprisonment
Rs. 10,000/- One month additional 
imprisonment
2. 308 of IPC 05 years’ R.I. 
imprisonment
Rs. 10,000/- One month additional 
imprisonment
Aforesaid sentences were directed to run concurrently.
4. As per office report, there is a delay of 64 days in 
filing the appeal.
5. Learned State counsel does not oppose the 
application seeking condonation of delay.
6. Accordingly, Delay Condonation Application (IA 
No. 1 of 2024) stands allowed and the delay of 64 days in 
filing the appeal is condoned.
7. Admit the appeal.
8. T.C.R. be summoned. 
9. The Registry is directed to prepare paper book after 
receiving the T.C.R. and supply the same to the learned 
counsel for the parties on their request, as per Rules.
10. List the matter on 07.01.2025.
11. Meanwhile, State counsel may file objection to the 
bail application.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 03.10.2024
BS/Akash
